articleTitle: Photonic technologies for phased array antennas
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation.

articleTitle: High-purity millimetre-wave photonic local oscillator generation and delivery
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Tunable millimetre wave generation by spectrally slicing a phase modulated lightwave is demonstrated. The low phase noise signal (-95 dBc/Hz at 100 kHz offset) can be delivered through a 9 km fibre link, with no noticeable power penalty.

articleTitle: Modulation bandwidth enhancement and nonlinear distortion suppression in directly modulated monolithic injection-locked DFB lasers
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We have experimentally investigated the dynamic performance and the suppression of nonlinear distortions of a monolithic optical injection-locked distributed feedback (DFB) laser. The master and the slave lasers are monolithically integrated in a single strip of strongly coupled DFB laser. Optical injection locking is achieved by current tuning. The resonant frequency of the laser is increased from 11 GHz to 23 GHz, and nonlinear distortions are suppressed by more than 15 dB.

articleTitle: A strained SiGe layer heterojunction bipolar phototransistor for short-range opto-microwave applications
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A strained-SiGe heterojunction bipolar phototransistor is presented for the first time. Theoretical demonstration of the device is recalled. Practical measurements at 940 nm are presented. A dc phototransistor mode responsivity of 1.49 A/W is achieved. Tools are proposed for the opto-microwave behavior analyses of photodetectors. A frequency behavior reaching 32 GHz with a -70 dBm output level and a 200 /spl mu/W input optical power is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 25-GHz channel spacing DWDM multiplexing using an arrayed waveguide grating for 60-GHz band radio-on-fiber systems
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a DWDM multiplexing scheme using an arrayed-waveguide grating for optically frequency interleaved 60-GHz band radio-on-fiber systems. No noticeable power penalty was observed after 25-km SMF transmission when the channel spacing was 25 GHz.

articleTitle: A single bandpass tunable photonic transversal filter based on a broadband optical source and a Mach-Zehnder interferometer
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We demonstrate a new single bandpass tunable microwave filter based on a broadband optical source and a fibre Mach-Zehnder interferometer. A tuning range of 5-17 GHz and a Q factor around 48 have been measured.

articleTitle: Radio-over-fiber transmission performance of OFDM signal for dual-band wireless LAN systems
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We propose the dual-band wireless LAN system based on radio-over-fiber technique. A demonstration of optical transmission of 5-GHz OFDM signal specified in IEEE802.11a and a feasibility of 2.4/5-GHz dual-band transmission will be reported.

articleTitle: WDM-SSB generation and dispersion mitigation in radio over fiber systems with improved performance using an AWG multiplexer with flat top resonances
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We present an improved version of a previously proposed multichannel (WDM) SSB modulator by replacing a Gaussian type AWG by another with flat top resonances. Over 3 dB improvement in the carrier suppression is obtained as compared with the typical Gaussian type resonance device.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 0 dB gain reactively matched optical links for very high purity signal distribution in s-band ground based radar systems
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Radar systems require transmission of very high purity local oscillators with both low phase noise and low insertion losses. We present optimized directly modulated reactively matched optical links, that exhibit 0 dB gain for frequencies below 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Dense wavelength division multiplexed optical wireless link towards terabit transmission
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A dense wavelength division multiplexing free-space optical link is presented that employs a fiber and free-space hybrid optical transmission technique. Basic transmission experiments are conducted and the results show the viability of terabit capacity free-space optical links.

articleTitle: High speed multi-beamfoming for wideband phased arrays
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.

articleTitle: Dense wavelength division multiplexing radio-on-fiber systems
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) millimeter-wave radio-on-fiber (ROF) systems are presented, in which we will focus on its multiplexing and demultiplexing techniques and photonic frequency conversions. The 25 GHz-spacing, 60 GHz-band DWDM ROF is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Harmonic generation of photonic microwave frequencies utilizing the properties of a phase modulator
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We present new techniques to generate a harmonic microwave frequency modulated on an optical carrier. All these techniques utilizes the properties of a phase modulator, and we achieve 40 GHz modulation using only 10 GHz electronics.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength NIR system for spectroscopy of biomedical tissues
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A custom designed optical system is reported for tissue spectroscopy over four wavelengths of 677 nm, 780 nm, 830 nm, and 977 nm. A high speed laser driver is designed with a flat frequency response using pre-emphasis circuit. The driver is employed for high current in high power lasers. Phantom and intra-lipid experiments are performed to extract optical parameters of a turbid media. Broadband measurement is used to extract optical parameters of the phantom model simulating a breast tissue using forward scattering models. The optical parameters () are extracted with a very good accuracy.

articleTitle: Multiband wireless LAN distributed antenna system using radio-over-fiber
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel radio-over-fiber multiband wireless LAN distributed antenna system and also describe a noise canceling technique applied to counteract the problem of received RF signal degradation caused by the noise generated by the O/E in a remote antenna unit.

articleTitle: Fibre-radio: challenges and possible solutions
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Rapid developments in lightwave and microwave enabling technologies have led to intense research efforts into millimetre-wave fibre-radio systems which offer the capacity to provide broadband interactive services. In this paper we present some of the technical challenges facing the implementation of such systems and propose some potential solutions.

articleTitle: 8 channels, 5 bits wideband optical beam steering up to Ku band
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The capability of optical technology to perform beamsteering over a large bandwidth without beamsquint is demonstrated on a 8 channels prototype operating in the 6-18 GHz frequency band. The angular coverage of 90/spl deg/ with 9 beam positions is realised by a 5 bits optical true time delay module covering delays from 6.4 ps to 178.4 ps.

articleTitle: The "effective" gains and noise figures of individual components in an analog photonic link
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This paper defines "effective" gains and noise figures for each component in an analog photonic link which, when inserted into the equation for the noise figure of cascaded components, yield the established link noise figure equation. Whereas the square-law electro-optic devices (modulator and photodetector) have effective gains that are - not surprisingly - dependent on RF power levels, it is found that the effective noise figures of the components that dominate the link noise figure are independent of RF power over the link's range of useful RF input power levels.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an efficient technique for optical generation of microwave signals based on a fiber loop mirror
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: An efficient scheme for the optical generation of a dispersion tolerant double-sideband with suppressed carrier (DSB-SC) signal is presented. A fiber loop mirror, offering an optical bandwidth of more than 130 nm is used to filter out the required sidebands.

articleTitle: A novel RF photonics band-pass filter
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A novel photonically implemented RF band-pass filter, using a comb-laser and a fiber dispersive medium is presented. Positive and negative taps are achieved by driving two Mach-Zehnder modulators with opposing quadrature biases.

articleTitle: Wavelength division multiplation technologies for UMTS radio coverage extension by using the radio over fibre technique
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This overview shows how the "radio over fibre" technology based on a CDWM or DWDM platform can offer a technically and economically attractive alternative to the traditional setting up of new sites in the roll-out of third generation cellular networks, making it possible to centralize the network equipment in special sites and to distribute small microcellular devices compatible with the growing demand for greater protection of the environment and public health.

articleTitle: Harmonic distortion in dispersive fiber-optical transmission of microwave signals
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Dispersion penalty has been investigated widely in 1550 nm fiber-optical links transmitting microwave (/spl mu/W) signals. However, less attention was addressed to the levels of harmonics. This paper presents theoretical and experimental results on estimation of harmonics in the transmission.

articleTitle: Sparse antenna array multiple beamforming and spectral analysis using spatial-spectral holography
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Fourier-plane spatial-spectral holography and a frequency-scanned, variable magnification holographic readout system are used to form squint-free broadband RF images from a coherently fiber-remoted, optically-modulated, randomly-spaced array antenna, which is phase cohered by a photorefractive crystal.

articleTitle: Optical THz generation
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This paper will report on recent achievements in the optical heterodyne signal generation at frequencies up to 1000 GHz. Special emphasis will be devoted to the development of 1.55 /spl mu/m optical transmitter chips and modules.

articleTitle: Direct microwave optical filtering: concept, configurations, and tunability issues
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The concept of direct microwave optical filtering is introduced. A microwave signal is transferred into the optical domain and processed by means of optical wavelength selective elements. A tunable quasi-passband direct microwave optical filter employing fibre Bragg gratings working in transmission is demonstrated experimentally. The aspects of stability and tunability of the filter are discussed.

articleTitle: A new approach for ultra-low phase noise millimeterwave opto-electronic oscillators
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This paper shows a new way for the enhancement of high Q - low phase noise millimeterwave opto-electronic oscillator structure. The new configuration enables us to improve the oscillator's noise characteristics without the need for the utilization of especially expensive and sensitive elements (such as high Q filters, etc.).

articleTitle: Frequency agile digitally tunable microwave photonic filter
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Digitally tunable microwave-photonic notch filters are demonstrated which are based on a differential group delay (DCD) module producing a relative delay between two orthogonal polarizations. A maximum rejection level greater than 60 dB has been stably obtained.

articleTitle: Investigations in the joint effect of fiber dispersion and nonlinear refraction in microwave optical links
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Transmission of optical signals intensity-modulated by an RF carrier is investigated. Linear and nonlinear effects are found to be independent as long as the nonlinear part of the fiber phase-constant less than one third of the dispersive part. Soliton-like effects are discovered at higher power levels.

articleTitle: Nonlinear characteristics of an SOA photonic frequency up-converter
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We investigate nonlinear distortion characteristics of the photonic up-converter using a semiconductor optical amplifier for multi-frequency signal up-conversion. The third order intermodulation distortions are measured and spurious free dynamic ranges are determined under various conditions.

articleTitle: On the use of single-sideband modulation for optical vector network analysis
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We investigate theoretically and experimentally the feasibility and the limitations of optical vector network analysis based on single-sideband modulation. It is found that the accuracy of the technique relies on a high suppression of the unwanted sideband.

articleTitle: Cost-effective photonic microwave filter employing tap reusing
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A technique to reduce the cost of photonic microwave filters based on WDM signals and dispersive media is presented. It allows to implement filters showing N/spl times/M taps using N+M components instead of N/spl times/M components, as required in previous proposals.

articleTitle: A compact RCS-range based on a phase hologram for scale model measurements at sub-mm-wavelengths
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The HUT Radio Laboratory develops a novel compact radar cross section (RCS) test range for scale model measurements. The test range is based on a phase hologram that converts the feed horn radiation to a plane wave. The measurements are performed using CW at 310 GHz in a quasi-monostatic radar configuration where the identical receiving and transmitting corrugated horn antennas are placed side by side. The feasibility of the phase hologram RCS range has been verified with simple test objects such as a metal sphere and a small metal plate. The work continues toward a monostatic radar configuration.

articleTitle: Optical sampling for high-speed, high-resolution analog-to-digital converters
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The combination of phase-encoded optical sampling and optical time-division demultiplexing has been demonstrated to extend the performance of electronic analog-to-digital converters (ADCs). We report a 10-effective-bit, 505-MS/s ADC with a spur-free dynamic range in excess of 70 dB.

articleTitle: The effect of a Mach-Zehnder modulator's traveling-wave electrode loss on a photonic link's noise figure
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The lowest achievable noise figure for an amplifierless photonic link using a traveling-wave external modulator is derived, assuming perfect, passive impedance matching. Expressions applicable to both lossless and lossy traveling-wave electrodes are presented.

articleTitle: Optically controlled phase-shifter based on gaps on microstrip line
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: An optically controlled phase-shifter has been designed taking benefit of high resistive silicon photo-absorption at 843 nm. Phase-shift of 85/spl deg/ has been achieved in the frequency range 18 GHz-28 GHz under very low optical power while the magnitude remains practically constant. Physical and electromagnetic modelling has been performed to explain optically controlled microwave effects in these microstrip structures.

articleTitle: Effects of directly modulated laser chirp on the performances of radio over fiber systems
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This paper presents a study of the performances of radio over fiber (RoF) systems in presence of fiber dispersion and spurious FM ("chirp") effects of directly modulated DFB lasers. Experimental results are successfully compared with theoretical ones.

articleTitle: Optical single sideband modulation using an injection-locked semiconductor laser as an optical filter
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We propose a new technique of generating optical single sideband (SSB) signals using an injection-locked semiconductor laser (SL). The injection-locked SL acts as an optical filter which filters out the undesired mode from the double sideband signals. 30 GHz optical SSB signals with our scheme are successfully generated.

articleTitle: Noise analysis and suppression for Nd:YVO/sub 4/ solid-state lasers
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This paper is intended to elaborate on the investigation and suppression of the relative intensity noise of a diode pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ microchip laser. In addition to the noise suppression at the relaxation oscillations, noise analysis is also reported.

articleTitle: Using phase inversion in an electro-optic modulator to implement RF incoherent photonic filters with negative coefficients
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel technical approach for the implementation of photonic RF filters that is based on the p phase inversion that a RF modulating signal suffers in a EOM Mach-Zehnder modulator depending on whether the positive or the negative linear slope of its modulation transfer function is employed.

articleTitle: Photonic multiple beam forming systems for broadband RF antenna arrays
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Two broadband, sparse array multiple beamforming optical processors are presented. These systems enable squint-free, true-time delay beamforming of large, randomly-spaced antenna arrays by compensating the frequency-dependent scale factor of the RF images produced by a Fourier optical imager.

articleTitle: High-directivity photonic emitter for 10-Gbit/s wireless link
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We present a high-directivity photonic emitter with a high-gain antenna and a waveguide-output photodiode module. The photodiode module is integrated with UTC-PDs and HEMT amplifiers. A wireless link with the emitter achieved 10-Gbit/s data transmission.

articleTitle: Noise properties of harmonically injection locked electronic and optoelectronic oscillators
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We describe mutual harmonic injection-locking of three oscillators. The particular locking process correlates noise components yielding a system phase noise (-120 dBc/Hz) lower than the best free running noise. Low jitter optical pulses are also generated.

articleTitle: Photonic beam steering in phased-array antennas
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A review of photonic beam former activities at TNO-FEL is reported. Both coherent and incoherent beam formers are presented. Optical beamforming is said to be the most suitable for true time delay beam forming, in which the relative bandwidth of the microwave signal referred to the optical carrier is almost zero.

articleTitle: Effect of optical reflection on nonlinear characteristics of direct modulated lasers
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The effect of optical reflection on direct modulated laser sources were experimentally studied. Key parameters of microwave optical links such as second and third order intercept point and spurious free dynamic range were measured as function of optical back-reflection level. MQW Fabry-Perot and DFB lasers were compared with short and long optical fibers.

articleTitle: Broadband LiNbO/sub 3/ modulator for digital and analog applications
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The chirp free X-cut LiNbO/sub 3/ modulators performance is presented here. We describe a digital long haul transmitter application and a preliminary characterization for analog applications.

articleTitle: Fiber radio link with microchip laser source
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This paper describes a fiber radio link, based on a solid-state dual microchip laser source. Experimental results are presented showing T3 rate downstream data transmission over the combined fiber radio and wireless link at 25.65 GHz.

articleTitle: EDFA-enhanced sensitivity of RF magneto-optical probe
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: EDFA-based sensitivity enhancement of MO field probe has been investigated experimentally and theoretically. It was found out that optical pre-amplification provides > 45 dB MO signal amplification and ASE-related noise reduction is a key issue.

articleTitle: Single monolithic hybrid mode-locked laser for multiple WDM channels mm-wave radio signal distribution
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We present a scheme for multiple (> 14) WDM channels mm-wave signal generation using a single monolithic hybrid mode-locked laser and experimentally demonstrate the generation of 155 Mbs BPSK data signals at 30 GHz frequency with different wavelengths.

articleTitle: A WDM/SCM star/tree fibre-feed architecture for pico-cellular broadband systems
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A star-tree mm-wave radio over fibre architecture for pico-cellular broadband systems is presented, and compared with other proposed architectures. Its feasibility is verified by detailed performance analysis in a commercial photonics physical layer simulator.

articleTitle: Improvement of linearity in EAM by composite QWs
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We propose a novel structure that improves the linear characteristic of a multiple quantum well (MQW) electro-absorption modulator (EAM). The transfer functions of EAMs composed of 8 nm, 9 nm and 10 nm quantum well (QW) were obtained and the combined transfer functions were investigated We found that the IMD3 of composite-type QW in which 12 nm : 8 nm = 1 : 3 was suppressed about 20 dBc compared with single-type QW.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave generation and baseband modulation by using reciprocating optical modulation for radio-on-fiber systems in V-band
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We demonstrated millimeter-wave generation by using reciprocating optical modulation. A light-wave modulated by V-band millimeter-waves was obtained from a micro-wave signal, and was also modulated by a baseband signal, using an optical phase modulator.

articleTitle: Modeling photo-induced plasmas in planar transmission lines for switching millimeter-wave signals
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Lumped and 3D-geometrical models are presented for a photo-induced plasma that induces local changes in the dielectric properties of the coplanar waveguide transmission line in order to switch propagating millimeter waves.

articleTitle: Microstrip line fed patch antenna with liquid crystal phase shifter for optically generated RF-signals
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We present a 1/spl times/2 phased array antenna with optical beamforming and integrated phase shifter. We are able to steer the radiation pattern by a continuous phase shift up to 360/spl deg/.

articleTitle: Two-beam two-channel optical T/R beamformer using ternary programmable dispersion matrix
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A single two-channel photonic beamformer based on a ternary programmable dispersion matrix is proposed and demonstrated to simultaneously process two independent RF beams. Beam patterns for two RF beams and various target positions are presented.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic modules for radio frequency over fiber from S-band to Ka-band
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.

articleTitle: Terahertz heterostructure lasers
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Unipolar semiconductor injection lasers emitting at THz frequencies have been demonstrated. The devices, based on the quantum-cascade scheme in GaAs/AlGaAs superlattices, operate in continuous-wave up to 50 K (70 K pulsed) with output powers of several mW.

articleTitle: Hybrid radio over fiber and baseband multiservice AWG-PON using CWDM and spectral periodicity of arrayed waveguide gratings
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A new configuration of an AWG-PON is presented capable of delivering, simultaneously fixed, switched and broadcast services, both in digital and in radio-over fiber format from the CO to the ONUs and viceversa. An experiment demonstrates the independent delivery of different, including very high speed signals downstream from 155 Mb/s to 10 Gb/s and wireless UMTS and HYPERLAN signals. Upstream remodulation by exploiting the delivery of an unmodulated carrier from the CO to the ONU is also shown.

articleTitle: Novel waveguide and materials structure for wideband electroabsorption modulator
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator using intra-step-barrier quantum well and peripheral coupled waveguide are designed and tested for analog fiber link applications. The resulting device has demonstrated high optical power handling and low V/sub /spl pi// properties.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic filter design employing a sampled grating based double-pass Er-doped fiber source
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new microwave photonic filter employing a sampled grating based double-pass Er-doped fiber source. The configuration overcomes the limitation of the spectral slicing method, and its performance is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Traveling wave electroabsorption modulator for ROF application
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We fabricated traveling wave electroabsorption modulator modules and observed high frequency response of up to 38 GHz. For the application to RF-on-fiber (ROF) system, the frequency response of traveling wave electrode and the RF termination were investigated.

articleTitle: The impact of optical illumination on the breakdown characteristics of pHEMTs
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The impact of optical illumination on the breakdown characteristics of pHEMTs is investigated for the first time. Illumination is found to influence deep-level trap related currents in the pHEMTs under test when V/sub DS/ > 2V.

articleTitle: Microwave signal generation with high spectral purity using two-frequency solid-state lasers
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Two-frequency solid-state lasers are shown to provide beat notes at microwave frequencies with continuous tunability, high spectral purity and 100% modulation depth. Owing to an intra-cavity birefringent crystal providing both electro- and thermo-optic properties, the laser delivers a beat frequency that is both voltage- and temperature-controlled. First, a dual phase-locked loop is experimentally demonstrated to stabilize a two-frequency solid-state laser against a RF synthesizer, resulting in a linewidth of 25 mHz. Second, we show that pump-power modulation can lead to a new two-frequency pulsed operation with pulse-to-pulse RF coherence. Third, a specially designed two-frequency composite Er-Yb:glass-LiTaO/sub 3/ microchip laser is shown to provide a beat note up to 100 GHz with continuous tunability. Applications of these lasers to local oscillators in microwave-photonic systems and to lidar-radars are discussed.

articleTitle: IST-OBANET: optical smart antennas for mm-wave broadband wireless access networks
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Several optical beamformer architectures are analyzed in terms of their performance for base station in broadband wireless access networks in millimeter-wave frequency bands. Both upstream and downstream configuration are described and their ability to offer multibeam capability has been considered. The measurements obtained confirm their performance. The work presented here has been carried out in the frame of the IST 2000-25390 OBANET project.

articleTitle: Optical subcarrier label swapping by semiconductor optical amplifiers in cross phase modulation wavelength converter block
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) can be used as an efficient high-speed modulator. The paper presents optical subcarrier multiplexed label swapping/reinsertion utilizing this device associated to the wavelength converter block in packet switched all optical networks. For that purpose the modulation response and nonlinear behavior of SOAs are analyzed and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Analysis of chirp characteristics and reduction of chromatic dispersion effects in microwave optical links
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The quantitative analysis of chirp characteristics in microwave optical links that reduced the dispersion effects by using a linearized DD-MZM with a gain saturated SOA for the various operating conditions was experimentally performed.

articleTitle: Dual Stokes wave generated by an actively mode-locked laser via the coherent stimulated Brillouin scattering in dispersion-shifted fiber
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The Stokes waves in DSF pumped by an AMLL reveal coherence with each other, resulting in the dual Stokes mode. Utilizing the behavior a novel method to recover the optical clock was proposed and demonstrated.

articleTitle: Improvement of dispersion resistance in analog radio-on-fiber upconversion links
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Simulations and measurements are carried out to evaluate dispersion resistance of up-conversion systems using one-electrode/push-pull Mach-Zehnder modulators or a passive unbalanced interferometer. This former solution causes very low fluctuations for mixing power as a function of fiber length.

articleTitle: Small signal and noise circuit model of vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) arrays for short range optomicrowave links
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: A circuit model of a vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) array and its experimental validation are presented in this paper. This model describes all optoelectronic phenomena including relative intensity noise (RIN) and electrical crosstalk.

articleTitle: Low phase noise microwave signal generation by injection locking to the sidebands of a multi-tone photonic oscillator
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We report low phase noise (-110 dBc/Hz at 10 kHz offset frequency) tunable microwave signal generation via a new technique of injection locking of DFB lasers to the optical sidebands of a multi-tone photonic oscillator.

articleTitle: High conversion gain millimeter-wave optoelectronic mixer based on InAlAs/InGaAs metamorphic HEMT
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We experimentally investigate the InAlAs/InGaAs metamorphic HEMT (m-HEMT) on GaAs substrate as a millimeter-wave optoelectronic mixer. The maximum internal conversion gain of 18.17 dB is obtained with 0 dBm local oscillator (LO) power. The m-HEMT exhibits a wide LO frequency range which is well extended to the millimeter-wave band. We also measured the spurious free dynamic range of the m-HEMT as an optoelectronic mixer, whose value is about 96 dBHz/sup 2/3/.

articleTitle: Dispersion effects and implementation errors on uniform fiber Bragg grating based true-time-delay beamforming networks
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Dispersion effects and implementation error on uniform fiber Bragg grating based true-time delay beamforming networks are studied. Two modulation schemes using double-side-band (DSB) modulation and single-side-band (SSB) modulation are considered.

articleTitle: Reduction of crosstalk impact on WDM system performance employing optical Fourier transformers
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: The use of optical Fourier transformer (OFT) for crosstalk noise redistribution in DWDM systems is proposed. A single mode fibre is employed in the OFT device. The principle of operation using 1.6 ps Gaussian optical pulses is experimentally demonstrated, OFT function in presence of linear crosstalk is theoretically evaluated and experimentally validated.

articleTitle: A channel selection scheme with optical heterodyne detection for DWDM/SCM millimeter-wave-band radio-on-fiber signal
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Channel selection for DWDM/SCM 60-GHz-band radio-on-fiber (ROF) signals by optical heterodyne detection with a dual-mode local light is investigated. Error-free detection of the DWDM/SCM ROF signals after 25-km-long SMF transmission and channel selection is demonstrated.

articleTitle: The conversion matrix for optical filters with arbitrary transfer function
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Full analytical expressions for the effect of an arbitrary optical transfer function on small signal RF modulations are presented. Simulations of a device, having both amplitude and phase variations, were performed to prove its validity.

articleTitle: Photocurrent effects in an electroabsorption modulator integrated with SGDBR laser
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: High photocurrent effects in an electroabsorption modulator are explored using the high output power from an integrated SGDBR laser followed by semiconductor optical amplifier. It is shown how the equivalent EAM junction resistance is reduced with photocurrent to lower than 30 /spl Omega/, how the modulation response is correspondingly affected and how the gain of electroabsorption-modulated analog links ultimately becomes limited by the absorbed photocurrent.

articleTitle: Time delay based optoelectronic processing of RF signals
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Optoelectronic architectures providing processing capabilities based on the generation of high precision time delays are reviewed.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic modules for radio frequency over fiber from S-band to Ka-band
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Optical components for commercial and defense systems are becoming readily available due to demand in new military applications in surveillance and countermeasures and commercial applications in communications. In defense systems such as phased array antennas and fiber optic decoys, high performance is required of the optical components both in narrow band for RF and wideband in countermeasure. In commercial applications, the expected high demand of two-way fixed and mobile wireless services, the consequent need of expanding the systems capacity, and the urgency of reducing the costs, has created an opportunity for the utilization of hybrid fiber wireless transport in wireless networks. These systems offer the potential to improve services and reduce base station costs through increased bandwidth and easy of installation. System demonstrations for personal communications services operating at 1.9 GHz up through Ka Band (26 to 40 GHz) have been developed. In many of these applications the key is to integrate the optical components with the microwave circuits to reduce size, cost and improve performance particularly at millimeter wave frequencies.

articleTitle: Variable true time delay realized with acousto-optics and liquid crystal spatial light modulator
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Optical heterodyne acousto-optic delay line applying frequency dependent phase shift provided by liquid crystal spatial light modulator is presented. We experimentally demonstrate continuously variable true time delay of 1 /spl mu/s long microwave pulses between /spl plusmn/300 ns.

articleTitle: Opportunities for microwaves and photonics in medical diagnostics and therapy
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Part I of this presentation discusses topics on RF/microwaves and optics in therapeutic medicine. The advances in the areas of RF/microwave cardiac ablation, RF/microwave treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), microwave balloon technology, RF in the treatment of sleep apnea, LED array for neonatal phototherapy and endoscopic light sources for photodynamic therapy (PDT) are specifically addressed. Part II presents various techniques available for breast cancer detection. Current limitations are discussed and future research trends are enumerated.

articleTitle: BER improvement effect of optical delay insertion in ROF ubiquitous antenna for road-to-vehicle wireless CDM system
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This paper proposes the application of optical delay insertion to radio-on-fiber ubiquitous antenna for road-to-vehicle wireless CDM system. As a result, the BER performance is improved by setting up delay time difference between each optical link appropriately.

articleTitle: A new spreading code generation method for DOS CDMA RoF system and its experimental investigation
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This paper proposes and experimentally investigates a new spreading code generation method to suppress aliasing distortions without using any processing at the receiver in DOS CDMA RoF system.

articleTitle: Tunable single-frequency erbium-doped fiber ring laser for microwave photonics applications
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel wavelength tunable single-frequency erbium-doped fiber ring laser. The single-frequency operation is realized by using a coupler loop mirror with an Er/sup 3+/-doped fiber saturable absorber, which acts as a narrow band optical filter. The fiber laser can find applications in microwave photonics systems.

articleTitle: Microwave signal processing using fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: This invited paper reviews the recent advances produced over the last years in the field of microwave, RF and millimetre signal processing using fiber Bragg gratings and photonic dispersive elements.

articleTitle: InP-based bipolar phototransistors for microwave photonic applications
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Fast optical detectors or optically controlled microwave devices are key elements of microwave photonic systems. With the development and maturity of InP technology, the monolithic integration of high-speed devices, detectors and transistors, into optical receivers has flourished. In an effort to produce a photodetector with intrinsic gain and ability to be integrated directly into an optoelectronic monolithic integrated circuit (OEMIC) with heterojunction bipolar transistors (HBTs), heterojunction bipolar phototransistors (photo-HBTs) have been widely investigated, in this paper, we will survey the state of the art performance of InP photo-HBTs and circuits based on this device.

articleTitle: Current profiling for /spl mu/m-class planar circuit patterns by fiber-edge magneto-optic probe
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: Inversion method of Biot-Savart's law has been successfully applied to one-dimensional current profiling for /spl mu/m-class planar circuits. Indispensable is to use a fiber-edge magneto-optic probe of high spatial resolution and high DUT-accessibility.

articleTitle: Photonic beam forming of mm-wave smart antennas
publicationTitle: MWP 2003 Proceedings. International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics, 2003.
abstract: In this contribution we present experimental results of optically controlled mm-wave array antennas which may be used in broadband mobile communication systems. Two operation principles have been investigated: downlink beam forming for transmission and uplink beam steering for optimization of the reception. In both cases the field distributions of the antennas were formed by a silica based photonic beam forming network.
